name: Basic Summoner Spellcasting
text: You gain the Basic Spellcasting Benefits. You gain the Cast a Spell activity. Your key spellcasting attribute for summoner archetype spells is Charisma, and they are summoner spells of your eidolon's tradition. You become trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. You gain a spell repertoire and two cantrips. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the summoner archetype, add a spell of the appropriate spell rank to your repertoire.
